evidence.quote: SeaWorld San Diego: Theme Park, Water Park & Zoo in California
Entertainment purchases include ticket purchases at movie theaters, sports promoters (professional and semi-professional live events), theatrical promoters, concert promoters, amusement parks,
Includes ticket purchases for live entertainment, including concerts, live sporting events, live theatrical productions, amusement parks, and orchestras.

draft.notes: The domain primarily sells theme-park admission, passes, upgrades, and events; merchandise is directed to the separate seaworldshop.com site. Some issuer definitions place amusement parks under Travel, but Entertainment explicitly includes amusement parks.
